chapter: Buck and Bubbles: Nazarro and Bubbles
title: The oasis gag in the Nazarro family pyramid
summary: Buck and Bubbles run through Nazarro's legs while he balances his sons and argue over seats; Green names Nazarro's sons and Nazarro's death.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: So they come running in -- when Nat Nazarra and his whole family were up on this pyramid, and what would they do?

Well, they was arguing and say, 'Well, that's an oasis.' Well, I don't see no oasis.' Well, ask that man up there, and he's in the process of balancing all these five sons, you know, and they go chasing each other. I mean Buck would run through Mr. Nazarra's legs, you know, and Mr. Nazarra's looking down at him running through there and, you know, 'What's going on, you know.

And Bubbles be chasing him (inaudible), say, I know I'm right. 'No, you can't be -- we paid your fair figure it sure (inaudible). Well, ask the man.' Say, Mister, there's -- say, can we sit down -- can we sit down there in them downstairs seats? Mr. Nazarra's trying to hold up his had all these five sons, see. Well, why do you ask me? Didn't you see an oasis?' (Inaudible). 'Well, ain't no oasis out there.

You see, each wants to know if I'm right or is he right or, see -- you know -- he was toppling, you know, and I run back there. I say, well, (inaudible). He's trying to balance his sons, you know, and the sons get in on it. And they say, 'Don't got up there yet,' you know. And it made Dad bitter, you see, and that's how Buck and Bubbles, you see,
they was becoming famous then. That was -- he was in the process of training them to the on and offstage process, you see.

And, well, he got attached to them, and eventually the Nat Nazarra and Sons act, I think they broke up, you see. They went off on their own, see. They become millionaires or something, see, and one of them is -- there's about three of them still alive, you see.

John Barner, that's one of Nat Nazarra's sons. What's the fellow that plays Mannix, O'Connor, he's another one, John Ireland. That's big brother John. He's one. And then there's Cliff Nazarra and Nat Nazarra, Jr. They're all alive. They're still alive.
And then -- well, the only one that's passed already is Mr. Buck. And, of course, Nat Nazarra, Sr., he passed some years ago. He passed in 1959, I think.
